schema_version.description: Request contract version; must be 1 when present.

repository.description: Absolute path of the Git repository to query. Defaults to the caller's workspace root; never inferred from the tool cwd.

command.description: Command name to trace, with or without a command: prefix; must not be blank.

depth.description: Traversal depth in edges; 1-10, default 5. The library also stops at 200 nodes and sets truncated.

confidence.description: Minimum resolution confidence: exact, import_resolved, same_module, or fuzzy_name (name-only matches, which include cross-crate callers through re-exports). Default same_module.
